ModMetaData.name: Beyond Our Reach :: Redux
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryła, ThatBartGuy, soldierGG1, Thadge, Octogiraffe, Pesky
ModMetaData.description:
Welcome to the future.
Beyond Our Reach :: Redux is the culmination of work that began in 2016, when I first started my journey with RimWorld. There were many iterations along the way: an unnamed mod pack created locally, then Beyond the Ambition of the Cosmic, and finally Beyond Our Reach.
This is the ultimate version of what I envisioned along the way. Years of editing, playtesting, commissions and fights - as well as friends I've found along the way.
Features
New technology An extended end game with three and a half new technology tiers: Solar, Kwazaari, Tenebral, and finally Umbral, a level of technology that seems truly Beyond Your Reach. - Solar technology - unlocked through research after Kylar-Xar Effect Computers - Kwazaari technology - unlocked through research and artifact analysis - Tenebral technology - unlocked through research and artifact analysis - Umbral technology - unlocked through research
New allies - The Solar Republics: a near-ultratech faction of benevolent colonizers with a peculiar link to the past.
New alignments - The Kwazaar Bazaar: an ultratech faction that might trade with you, if you earn the right.
New challenges - Badzaari raiders, clad in heavy armor and armed with dangerous new weapons, will raid and mince your colonists. - Tenebral Harvesters, clad in crystalline armor and hellbent on eviscerating your people - quite literally.
New bionics - Solar bionics improve versions of implants from vanilla and the DLCs. - Kwazaari bionics improve on Solar designs and combine their effects. - Tenebral bionics offer a tremendous jump in power and combined capabilities, but wielding them is painful. - Umbral bionics are even more powerful and painless, but require an unbuildable material to install.
New mechanoids - Solar lifters and cleansweepers: faster and more durable. - Kwazaari drillers and fabricors: faster and more skilled.
New weapons Solar weapons come in three types: beam, gauss, and ballistic, with textures inspired by XCOM 2 and Xenonauts. Kwazaari weapons come in three types: ballistic, totally-not-bolters, and non-lethal brain zappers, with textures inspired by Helldivers and XCOM 2. Tenebral weapons come in one type: quasi-ballistic bleeder-hurters.
New armor - Solar marine armor - an improved marine armor (inspired by Mass Effect N7 Armor) - Solar recon armor - a faster version of marine armor with less durability (inspired by Winged Hussars) - Solar daedalus armor - a light, jump-pack enabled armor available with Royalty (inspired by XCOM Archangel Armor)
- Kwazaari marine armor - even more durable marine armor (inspired by Helldivers 2) - Kwazaari recon armor - a straight upgrade to recon armor (inspired by Roman Legionnaires) - Kwazaari mechlord armor - an upgrade to the mechlord armor from Biotech (inspired by Starship Troopers movies)
- Tenebral marine armor - best armor available in the mod (not inspired by daedra though i see why you would say that) - Tenebral machine lord armor - best mechanitor armor available with Biotech (inspired by Skitarii)
New apparel - Each tier gets a bodysuit as the ultimate piece of clothing. - A lot of special apparel designed to improve various stats introduced by the mod: - Assembly Carapace - Kwazaari flak armor doubling as a neutronium conversion exosuit - Assembly Harness - Solar flak armor doubling as a neutronium conversion exosuit - various headpieces and gloves and coats assisting with the mod's work
New materials - Sunsteel and sunweave - metal and fabric on another level than the base materials - Quasar alloy and Quasar alloy weave - improved versions of the above - Tenebrite - weird crystals filled with blood and pain, allowing you to craft indestructible constructs
- Neutronium - a deep pumpable (similar to Deepchem) resource that has to be harvested from beneath the ground and kept in powered tanks - as a reward for losing power, you get fireworks! - Neutronium is used as explosive component in shells, explosive (and CE special ammo) - Neutronium is used to craft basically anything on special fueled benches - you can craft a mech healer serum, for example, as long as you have the fuel - without other ingredients! - Neutronium is used as fuel for power plants
New recreation - TVs! - PCs! - Holographic games! - Telescopes! - DRUGS!
New buildings - (hopefully) every single thing from vanilla is recreated allowing you to raise your tech-level within the concepts you already know. - 4 Power Generators, scaling from 80 000 kW to infinity! - 5 research enablers! - 4 crafting benches! - 3 new medical benches! - 4 neutronium forges, allowing to use neutronium as basis for replicationfabrication - 3 new hydroponics - 3 new turrets - 2 new artillery pieces - Pollution pumps! - Deep drills! - Sleep accelerators! - New batteries! - New tool cabinets!
New medicine - Solar, Kwazaari and Tenebral level medicine! - Sleep, speed-mode and happy drugs!
New permits - With Royalty loaded, Kwazaaris offer a whole career with permits and drops!
Cross-mod integrations (most are optional): - Kwazaaris can have a bank with Vanilla Trading Expanded - Combat Extended fully integrated and expanded with new shells, ammunition, vehicle ammunition - Adaptive Storage Framework enabled with additional buildings - Archotech Expanded is toned down a bit and made to reuse BOR's similar materials - Bionic Icons supported! - Biotech supported with armor, mechs, implants, pumps and xenotypes! - Chemfuel Powered Deepdrill mod allows you to use 2 additional refuelable deepdrills! - Dubs Bad Hygiene allows to use better bionics - letting you basically disable those needs on worthy pawns - Even More Linkables allows you to use 2 additional power-improving linkables. - EPOE lets you build all kinds of ribs! - Show Me Your Hands is supported with custom hand positions for all weapons! - EGI Holograms and Projectors pulls the holograms into BOR tech tree. - Ideology supported with sleep accelerators and style patches - a bunch of small integrations for mods where you can build weird things from neutronium - including kraltech or more archotech garbage - LTS Integrated Implants supported with the socket things - MedPod is integrated into Kwazaari tech tree with a lot of research - Quantum Cooling Redux is integrated across the tech tree and rebalanced a bit to make it more powerful and more dangerous - Repair Hubs are integrated as solar/quasar technology. - Replimat is integrated as quasar technology. - Reverse Engineered Region Adjusters are integrated across the tech tree. - There are bionics similar to Royalty ones when Royalty is loaded, as well as a whole permit system for Kwazaari faction and a special, jetpack armor for Solar tier. - Save Our Ship is in general supported to the level of EVA patching. - with Simple Learning, all PCs double as learning desks. - with Solar Flare Shield, the original shield is integrated into tier 2, with 2 additional shields being available on solar and tenebral level - with TerraPumps, you get all 3 tiers of all the pumps. - with Medical Expansion - Vaccines, you get new recipes and new vaccine types - with Vanilla Skills Expanded, you get new expertises for this mod's worktypes - with Winston Waves, BOR resources can be seen as rewards
